code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if h == 2 * r + 1 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
            if len(shared) == 1:
                color = next(iter(shared))
                return [[3 if top[i][j] == color and bottom[i][j] == color else color
                         for j in range(w)] for i in range(r)]
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if w == 2 * c + 1 and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
            if len(shared) == 1:
                color = next(iter(shared))
                return [[3 if left[i][j] == color and right[i][j] == color else color
                         for j in range(c)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('No unique shared color across equal panels')
'''
